_note: What a companion is made of, rolled once when she is first given (Companions.roll, seeded by her player's id, so the same player gets the same roll), and kept in her record. One call to the voice model then writes her card, a paragraph, from these, and one sentence of how she and her player met (decision 293). Each entry is a few plain words, never prose or a line to say. 'trade' in a profession is the trade she works in a town she stays in (decision 284; one of levels/economy.json's, or empty for none). In how_we_met, {player} is her player's name and {pronoun} her own. Lore will supply birthplaces and names per region once facts are agreed.

growth._note: Her card grows (decision 294): at most facts_max facts about her (over it, the oldest of what she witnessed is merged into a short history) and beliefs_max beliefs about the world (the oldest dropped); her voice is told them within prompt_chars characters, her newest event_facts_shown witnessed facts among them; what was said with her player is read for new facts once a stretch of at least talk_lines lines of theirs has been quiet for quiet_seconds.

guide._note: Her guiding (decision 551): she leads her player to a place or area she has been with them (record.companion roads), on the world's routes, waiting while they are more than wait cells behind; there within arrive cells of it; a stopped walk is taken up again by 'lead on' within keep_minutes; her voice is told the nearest places_told places she knows the way to; it stops when her player falls under hurt_below of their hp. What she lived through somewhere is kept as a danger of that area with its weight (weights; 'hurt' when a blow leaves her or her player under hurt_mark of their hp), the heaviest a day per area and kind; the refusal by weight comes in phase 2. What she hears of the roads (551 phase 2, npc's side, RoadKnowledge): a wagon struck by a camp is a heard danger of the camp's area at heard_weights; a danger weighs its whole for fresh_days of its kind, then straight down to nothing at twice that; a camp nobody holds drops its heard dangers, and a passage through an area without a stop halves that area's dangers once a day. Her refusal (551 phase 2, companions'): asked, she will not walk a road whose dangers (their faded weights on its areas) reach her nerve: boldness by her temperament (boldness_default for one not listed), plus bond by her Standing word with her player, plus company for each other player beside them; she names the worst, offers to go as far as the last place short of them, and refuses the same goal the rest of the day; drafts for Jeff.

bandage_says._note: What she says when she won't or can't bandage (decision 625, Jeff: 'Pip seems lazy at bandaging ... just says fine'), at once, no model, by World.bandage_refusal's reason or bandage_broke_why; a key with _self is for her own wound. Drafts for Jeff.
bandage_says.not_safe: Not here. Not with them this close.
bandage_says.hurt_now: Give it a breath. We're still bleeding from that.
bandage_says.mending: It's bound already. Give it time.
bandage_says.patient_moved: Hold still, or I can't bind it.
bandage_says.moved: I had to move. Let me start again.
bandage_says.hurt: That broke it off. Let me start again.
bandage_says.not_beside: I can't reach you from here.
bandage_says.low: Not now. I have to get clear of it first.

loyalty._note: Her loyalty shown in what she does, and the warning signs before leaving (decision 555; drafts for Jeff). Her bond's step with her player from her Standing score: devoted and close at Standing's top and trusted, wary at its wronged (residents.json 'standing'), cooling, sullen and apart at steps; else fond. heel_start: how far her player gets before she sets off (Heel.START 3 otherwise). Wary or colder she fights only what is at her or after them, never presses, and pulls back under retreat_below of her hp; devoted she stands over her downed player. At grave_superstition or more (her 442 leaning) she won't touch grave goods below close. Sullen or colder she takes only food and a gift (gear into a free slot). Decision 621 (Jeff: 'wary hesitates and refuses risky orders; close follows; devoted takes the lead when asked and protects you aggressively'): only devoted leads; wary or colder says a hesitate line and acts on a plain order Companion.HESITATE_TICKS later; devoted goes first at whatever is attacking her player. words: what her voice is told of her step (%s her player); guide_words: whether she leads.

bond._note: Her bond with her player (decision 444, on npc's Standing, 443; tiered by decision 621, Jeff's: 'each tier has its own deeds; the deeds that got you to a tier can't raise you further'). Standing's COMPANION ladder: fond to start, wary at -3, close at 3, devoted at 6 (residents.json 'standing'). deeds: each raise's tier; tiers: what one deed of the tier adds (each, halves carried on her record as bond_carry) and the score it raises her to at most (up_to): warmth (fond to close: gifts, food, days together, plain bandaging) to close, trust (close to devoted: tending her badly hurt, standing by her, a camp cleared, a new ability) to one short of devoted, milestone (a rescue, the draugr's blessing, an area's reward) as far as Standing goes. Each deed raises her once a game day. Lower deeds repair lost points up to her best (bond_best) but never past the top of the step she is at. No decay over time. drops: what each hurt costs, at any step (damage never costs her bond: 'struck' is gone). The deeds she sees (Companion._watch_deeds, by watch): road (road_cells walked with her player in a game day, road_share on roads), fire (both within fire_cells of a fire, fire_ticks), leisure (in a town town_ticks), and the drops mule (her slots over heavy_share for heavy_cells walked, warned at half, once until she rests) and pressed (a new fight while under low_hp after she asked to rest). fought: a monster killed where both landed a blow; finished: the last hostile camp of an area cleared with her. harsh: her voice's [HURT] on her player's words, at most harsh_a_day a game day, a [SORRY] the same day taking one back. game: knucklebones by a fire ('play knucklebones'), a round a round_ticks, best_of, the first each day warmth. sleep: after a hard day (a fight since she slept, or under hard_hp) by a fire with her player she asks them to keep watch once a day; yes, or them staying within near answer_ticks, and she sleeps sleep_ticks: whole and rested after, watched (trust); gone past near and something comes, she wakes with left_line, left_alone. All drafts for Jeff.

leaving._note: Decision 581 (Jeff: 'companion keeps their blessings and abilities but goes back to their home town to live and work their vocation ... would never become an enemy'): at the bottom step (apart) she leaves her player, at the next calm moment; on the last straw (its deed, when her bond is at or below its step) too, even dead, when she is next back. She walks to the zone's nearest way out for at most walk_s, gone there or once out of their sight, and lives in her home town as a resident. Drafts for Jeff.
leaving._favour: Winning her back (581 amended, Jeff: 'based on their personality, come back if you build favor back up with them, say your reputation improves, if they are justice driven, and you repair that'): while she is away her bond fades toward nothing (Standing.decay) and moves only by what reaches her town, once a game day each: favour's gift (on a visit), errand (a job for her town) and reputation (her town's residents' mean standing toward them at reputation_at or above, Townsfolk.reputation; times justice_reputation for the justice-driven). She goes with them again (581 amended (2)) at return_at or above, and, at justice_at or more (CompanionCard.justice), once the deed she left over is put right: repairs, by deed (else reputation): temple (their blessing spent on another in her town), visit (food brought her, then visit_hours near her, within visit_cells), grave (the grave goods back where they were taken, or in a temple's store), camp (a hostile camp in the area she warned of taken). words: her two sentences for her resident voice (npc's set_left), %s her player. All drafts for Jeff.

focus._note: Her focus (decision 577, Jeff's: 'what combination of fighting, magic, and stealth they tend to use ... a spider chart where you only have say 100% focus, and growing positively can pull from the others'): fight, magic and stealth on her record (record.companion['focus']), summing to 100, none under floor. Rolled from even, moved by her profession and temper (lean), the legacy three fixed; grown by what she does (grow: event -> [focus, points]), each gain taken from the other two in proportion, at most daily_cap points a game day. lean_at: the share from which she leans one way (her voice told so; a new lean is a fact). multiplier: [base, per share] for Companion.focus_of (0.8 + 0.4 x share / 100), what enemy-ai reads. All drafts for Jeff.

legacy._note: Companions from before the roll, kept (Jeff): a companion with one of these names keeps it, and her 'fixed' facts are seeds the roll keeps, the rest rolled round them; a new roll never gives the name. Keys of 'fixed' replace the rolled trait of that name; others ('who', 'aspiration', 'though': what stands against the aspiration) are added to what the card is written from. 'look' is her fixed look (decision 293 amended, for 419); 'leanings' her intellect and superstition (decision 442; drafts for Jeff). They rest in town between trips: when their player leaves the game they go to the town's stockpile and wait (decision 293).
